## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Preserve the public provider contract where practical.

## Evidence

List relevant offline tests, builds and any opt-in native measurements. Distinguish synthetic/local tests, live queries, simulators and physical devices. Report failures and sample sizes; link the benchmark methodology when applicable.

## Provider or privacy changes

For a new/changed backend, link current official access terms, quotas and privacy documentation. Explain whether it is keyless, evaluation-only, commercially authorized or permission-gated. Include only sanitized public evidence; no tokens, private queries, response dumps or session identifiers. State extra disclosures/requests introduced by concurrency or caching changes.
